name: Dedicated line-protection CT core interface
summary: Identifies the assigned line-bay CT circuit serving its protective relay.
description: Identifies the assigned line-bay CT circuit serving its protective relay. A current-transformer secondary arrangement carries a measuring current from a defined primary location to metering or protection inputs. Core identity, polarity and the connected circuit determine the measurement's meaning.

In a substation protection panel, separate CT cores can supply metering and protection circuits with different duties. A test boundary must preserve the secondary arrangement required by the selected CT and test device. For this reference, the drawing identifies “Line-bay CT core” at the input and “Line relay current input” at the output. The bay measurement boundary must be stated.
